verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. Any OpenAI SDK can call `https://api.morphllm.com/v1` with one API key, and it supports offline batch completions and create/poll Reflex training jobs. A community user also drove it from a CLI tool (llm) through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official CLI, and a published OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404).
